marker: # unit_length and ref_repeats are Table 1 of Nouvel et al. 2008, which gives, for each of the four
# VNTRs in the sequenced type strain PG2, the repeat unit length and the copy number. The copy
# numbers are fractional at three loci, 2.3, 3.6 and 2.3, because those arrays are imperfect, with
# 72 to 83 per cent internal identity in the paper's own count, so the reference allele lies on a grid
# offset from the integers; Magal_VNTR14 is a clean 2.0. The paper itself recorded profiles as
# arbitrary allele codes rather than these copy numbers, so an allele from this scheme is the repeat
# number and may not match a published allele code.
# ref_size is the product these primers give in the PG2 assembly GCA_000063605.1. It equals the total
# length Table 1 reports at Magal_VNTR5 (226), Magal_VNTR14 (158) and Magal_VNTR17 (209). At
# Magal_VNTR19 the measured product is 184 against a reported 153, and the paper's own genomic span
# for that locus, 504535 to 504760, is 226, so the three figures disagree in the source; the measured
# product is used because ref_size must describe the assembly the calls are anchored on. No repeat
# unit sequences are stored, because the arrays are too imperfect to cross-check.
